pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   C. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

3. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   B. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   B. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Say Joseph interprets a Dream has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Joseph interprets a Dream.
   C. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Attributes of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of God.
   D. Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zacchaeus the Tax Collector has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
   B. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

12. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Zacchaeus the Tax Collector and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Balaam’s Donkey and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Samson kills a Lion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Joseph interprets a Dream and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
